title.tr: Villa Bahçesinde Kafes Panelli Ahşap Pergola
title.en: Wooden Pergola with Lattice Panels in a Villa Garden

alt.tr: Taş kaplı zemin üzerinde kafes panelli, üstü kirişli açık renkli ahşap pergola; arkada villalar ve çim alan
alt.en: Light wooden pergola with lattice panels and slatted roof on a paved base, villas and lawn in the background

caption.tr: Konut sitesi bahçesinde, taş kaplı zemine kurulmuş kirişli ahşap pergola. Yan yüzlerde kafes paneller var.
caption.en: A wooden pergola with a beam roof on a paved slab in a residential garden, with lattice panels on the sides.
